_sync: tools/bundle_runtime.py re-implements den-runner's search in Python:
system_candidates() mirrors candidates() and find_core_dir() mirrors
core_dir() in crates/den-runner/src/locate.rs. The two lists must move
together: a path added on one side is added on the other.
_comment: Where tools/bundle_runtime.py --from-manifest downloads a RetroArch from.
The URLs below are libretro's published build locations. They are NOT
pinned to a hash yet, and they were not verified from the environment this
file was written in, which cannot reach that host. Run
once on a machine with network: it downloads, prints the sha256, writes it
here, and every later run verifies against it. Until a sha256 is recorded
the script refuses to stage a download, so an unpinned entry can never be
--from-archive is the surer route for a release: download a build yourself,
check it, and hand the file to the script.
